mentions.name: Xelly Games
mentions.description: A social network for small games: users post mini games to social feeds, scroll the feed like a social network, and tap any game to jump in and play it. Games are served into fully locked-down, sandboxed iframes for security.
mentions.source_excerpt:

Games are served into fully locked-down, sandboxed iframes for security.
